remarks: Charming second-floor unit with some utilities included. Spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence perfectly blends modern updates with comfortable living. Step inside to discover a beautifully renovated kitchen, thoughtfully designed with sleek finishes and ample storage-ideal for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. The brand-new primary bedroom suite offers a serene retreat, featuring a luxurious bathroom and plenty of closet space. Natural light fills every room, enhancing the warm and inviting atmosphere. Enjoy access to a shared backyard and a dedicated gardening area, perfect for outdoor relaxation or cultivating your green thumb. Additional convenience comes with one assigned parking space. Situated just moments from all modes of transportation, Greenwich Avenue, and some of the finest dining establishments, this home provides the perfect balance of suburban tranquility and urban accessibility. Experience the best of Greenwich living at 37 Gerry Street-your new place to call home. Interior photos coming very soon.
